name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.4: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. Infantry cover and damage rework (buildings 30%, tank/autocannon/HMG anti-infantry x0.8, HEAT = HE, Ignore Cover only on special rounds), tank HEAT tiers and high-end IFV class, China balance patch, Blue Dragon testing preview (Arsenal only), creator paint schemes on 74 China units, Z-19/Z-9WA 4 pylons, Multiplayer opens Mod Lobbies, helicopter range stat, match results by FA score. Includes everything in 0.9.3. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.50.
